### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **59** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/core.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**48** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bbb49c9fe3ecfa56c843aac7a18d4ff95783047a`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/core.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `ObjectQL (symbol, 78 pages)`
- **12** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bbb49c9fe3ecfa56c843aac7a18d4ff95783047a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ca6217aebd23054d8a52c062babf09289179eb56` — the merge of head `490c3c331a2132a8b60506d5b82127807822265d` into base `bbb49c9fe3ecfa56c843aac7a18d4ff95783047a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ca6217aebd23054d8a52c062babf09289179eb56 && git checkout ca6217aebd23054d8a52c062babf09289179eb56
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin bbb49c9fe3ecfa56c843aac7a18d4ff95783047a 490c3c331a2132a8b60506d5b82127807822265d && git checkout -B drift-repro bbb49c9fe3ecfa56c843aac7a18d4ff95783047a && git merge --no-ff 490c3c331a2132a8b60506d5b82127807822265d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bbb49c9fe3ecfa56c843aac7a18d4ff95783047a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs bbb49c9fe3ecfa56c843aac7a18d4ff95783047a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
REWORK round 1 · PR #27403 @ `55356b9f` · 2026-10-29T05:33Z

Seat review plus an independent full Fable review. `git range-diff` shows the rebased objectql/spec commits are identical to `4dab7de7`/`9f121199`. Ran locally: the three new objectql test files (129/129), spec ledger + external-errors tests (37/37), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-error-status-conformance`, and the Clause-② line parse (`yes`). All green.

Most of the PR is accepted as is:
- Floor coverage is complete: all 13 engine read sites go through the map entry, and `defaultDriver` is a name.
- `===` identity holds.
- The evaluator refuses unknown operators by name, and the four spec tables pass.
- The cap is exact at 1000/1001 and never truncates.
- The 5xx failure path withholds the remote's message.
- The ledger rows match their neighbours.
- The changeset is patch with the BREAKING banner, which follows AGENTS.md.
- The spike re-pin weakens nothing.
- The docs match the code, including the `columnMap` correction.

## Must fix

1. **Blocker: the floor is removed by a driver-less re-registration.** `applyExternalDriverFloor` unwraps whenever `needsExternalDriverFloor(def)` is false, and that is false when `def.driver` is absent. `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-connection-service.ts:669` and `:851` (`restoreOldPool`) call `registerDatasourceDef({ name, schemaMode, external })` without `driver`, because `EngineDatasourceDef` has no such key.
   - Sequence: the stack install registers the def with `driver`, `registerDriver` floors it, then line 669 overwrites the def without `driver`, which unwraps the floor.
   - The reviewer reproduced it: a where-ignoring driver then answers all rows.
   - Today only the default factory's `skipped-unsupported` exit, and the spike's `already-registered` exit, keep it hidden.
   - **Fix in objectql:** a def whose `driver` is `undefined` keeps the previously stored driver id, so it never unwraps on an absent key. Add a test for exactly this sequence.
   - Passing `driver` from the connection service is a spec-contract touch (`EngineDatasourceDef`), so it is not in this PR. The seat carries it as a follow-up.
2. **Auth and rate-limit refusals must not surface as `EXTERNAL_WRITE_REFUSED`.**
   - `write()` maps every 4xx to 422 and passes the remote's text verbatim. An expired token or a rate limit is an operator condition, and the text may name the credential.
   - Carry only request-shaped refusals (400/404/409/412/422) as `EXTERNAL_WRITE_REFUSED`.
   - Send 401/403/407/429 to `ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` (503, `reason: 'remote'`, cause logged).
   - Pin both with tests and say it in the docs.
3. **Dev question (a), seat ruling: hide `updateMany` / `deleteMany` in the floor Proxy** (`get` → `undefined`, `has` → `false`), exactly as `aggregate` is hidden.
   - The engine's one predicate-write site (`updateByIdExpecting`, engine.ts ~14389, the ADR-0142 D4 precondition) then takes its existing documented degraded path, `driver.update` by id.
   - The ruling's "writes pass through" still holds: every write reaches the driver, by id.
   - This removes the case where a driver ignores `where` and bypasses the precondition. Add a test and update the docs' "Not covered" bullet.
4. **`compareRows`:** a `Date` and an ISO string in one column compare as number vs string and read as equal. Normalise both to epoch ms when either side is a date, and add a test.
5. **Docs nits:**
   - "the page at offset 1000 is refused" holds only when more than 1000 rows match; say so.
   - Under step ①, add "honour `limit` by paging the remote; a remote whose page is smaller than 1001 and that you do not page through answers fewer rows than match, and the engine cannot detect it."

## Accepted as is, with follow-ups the seat files

- **Dev question (b):** a `ReadableIds` leaf refused (ADR-0139 D3) is strictly safer than main. Controlled-by-parent external objects stay unreadable in P1, as the docs already say. The engine semi-join is a follow-up card.
- **Read throws become 503:** this covers even a driver's own 400-band filter refusal. It matches the ruling. Passing 400-band read refusals through is a follow-up.
- **`external-errors.ts` left untouched** is intended: the two codes are not ADR-0015 gate codes. The claim listed that file as surface, not as an obligation.

Same branch, same claim. The Fable review re-reads the delta after the push.

ACCEPT · PR #27403 @ `490c3c331a2132a8b60506d5b82127807822265d` · 2026-10-29T07:16Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 插件 driver 承载的外部数据源有了引擎兜底。引擎只向 driver 发 `where + orderBy + limit 1001`，拿回行后在内存里重做完整查询（筛选、排序、分页、字段）。超过 1000 行时响亮拒收（422 `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_EXCEEDED`，带处方）。远端拒写 422 `EXTERNAL_WRITE_REFUSED`，带远端消息；鉴权、限流、5xx、不可达都是 503，消息不外泄。多行谓词写在这类数据源上拒收并给处方。指南补上三段。
- **为什么改：** 裁决 6487532394（Q1=B、Q2=A′、Q3=A′）。driver 不能选择性忽略筛选，否则虚拟对象会静默返回错行。
- **风险与回滚：** 只影响「非托管 + driver 不是内置 id」的数据源；内置 driver、联邦 SQL、托管库零变化。changeset 为 patch 加 BREAKING 横幅（超 1000 行改为拒收）；还原即回滚。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/external-driver-floor.ts`、`driver-query-in-memory.ts`、`engine.ts` 的 `applyExternalDriverFloor`；账本两行 `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** 单跑 `external-driver-floor.test.ts` 与 `driver-query-in-memory.conformance.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：ACCEPT。两轮返工后，独立 Fable 完整复核 ACCEPT；第二轮的拒收措辞由席位亲读。

## 席位核对

1. **Shape:** the seat read the diff (5 commits, +1611/−47). An independent full Fable review covered round 0 (`55356b9f`, whole PR, spec commit included) and the round-1 delta (`55356b9f..7561b148`). It confirmed with `range-diff` that the rebase changed no code. The seat read the round-2 delta (`7561b148..490c3c33`: a named refusal for multi-row predicate writes on a floored driver, generic text kept for every other driver).
2. **Premise measured:** all 13 engine driver read sites go through the floored map entry. `===` identity holds. A driver-less re-registration keeps the floor; that is the blocker fixed in round 1, with a test of the connection-service sequence. The cap is exact at 1000/1001 and never truncates. The evaluator refuses unknown operators by name, and the four spec conformance tables pass. A 401/403/407/429 write withholds the remote text; that is tested.
3. **Gate check-runs on `490c3c33`:** 50 runs: 41 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed or pending. `mergeable_state: clean`. The dev's local results: objectql 483 files / 9088 tests and typecheck green. All 110 derived gate families exited 0 on round 1, and the 45 objectql families exited 0 on round 2. Dogfood: 2806 passed, 0 failed.
4. **Accepted deviations:** branch `claude/project-thread-mlrxgx` (platform exception, in the claim). The runtime P0 spike was re-pinned to the floor; the review confirmed no assertion was weakened. The generated reference docs ride with the spec commit. `packages/spec/src/shared/external-errors.ts` is untouched on purpose: the two codes are not ADR-0015 gate codes.
5. **Out of scope, filed or carried:** follow-ups filed by the seat after landing: the connection service passes the driver id (`EngineDatasourceDef`, spec contract), the `ReadableIds` semi-join for controlled-by-parent external objects, and passing 400-band read refusals through. `Clause-②: yes` (two ledger codes) · `Metadata-protocol: none` · contract review: the independent full Fable review of the spec commit stands as it, per the project rule for spec changes.
6. **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 27403`: 1658 lines ≤ 3000). Landed by the seat through the relay on the maintainer's order (田騏 2026-10-29T04:19Z: 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能处理 issue 和 pr 落地」).
